title: Reading progress bar
purpose: Fixed top-of-viewport 6px track whose purple fill width follows the page scroll fraction. Rendered as the first child of the post page; no transition.
retrievalIneligibleReason: Fixed 6px reading-progress indicator driven by scroll position; it carries no content and must never be retrieved as a section.

content.budgetRule: maxWords/maxChars = the maximum observed in the clone's own content for this field across every rendered instance (schema/examples/reference/*); list sizes = observed min/max. Never exceed; shorter is allowed.

assets.note: reference mode may use referenceRoles; generated mode must use generatedRoles (generation-safe only). See assets/asset-roles.json.

style.note: token props take token-catalog paths only (tokens/llm/token-catalog.json); allowed values = values observed in the clone (tokens/llm/token-policy.json styleProps).

responsive.behavior: fixed, full viewport width, z 50, 6px tall
